news.headline: This may be the ‘missing piece’ for investors looking to boost AI exposure
news.summary: Matthews Asia is positioning its portfolio strategy around exposure to the world's second-largest economy—a potential missing piece for investors seeking to deepen their AI bets. The approach taps into growth opportunities beyond traditional Western tech hubs.

news.headline: Bitcoin ETFs Notch Seven-Day Winning Streak as 2026 Flows Turn Green
news.summary: Bitcoin ETFs are on a seven-day winning streak, pulling in nearly $3B and flipping 2026 flows from red to green. The rally erases recent losses tied to the Clarity Act, signaling renewed institutional demand for crypto's biggest asset.

educational.title: How Venture Capital Actually Funds Startups
points: VCs invest other people's money (a "fund") in exchange for equity, not loans
Most funded startups fail — VC math relies on a few huge wins covering the rest
Funding rounds (seed, Series A, B...) mark stages of growth and rising valuation
Taking VC money means giving up some ownership and control in exchange for capital
Not every business should raise VC — it's built for high-growth, high-risk bets
